name: Maize Development through Cluster Approach Scheme
benefit: - Under the scheme, quality seeds shall be supplied to farmers at subsidized rates for higher yield.
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Meghalaya.
1. The applicant should be a bonafide farmer engaged in agriculture.
1. The applicant should have sufficient available cultivable land of (0.025 hectares).
